thread:
Anya: Quick sync — need a concrete decision on what ships in the next sprint (MVP) vs what we push to v1. Proposing we ship embeddings cache + basic eviction, but defer tenant-level analytics and RBAC-by-role to v1. Rationale: caching hits reduce token cost ~22% and latency P95 by ~18% in perf runs; RBAC and telemetry require infra changes that risk slip.

Anya: Proposed cutlist (short):
```
- Keep: embeddings cache (core), public KV eviction policy (LRU), basic metrics for cache hit/miss
- Defer to v1: per-tenant telemetry dashboards, role-based access controls for cache config, advanced cache warming
- Optional for MVP if time: simple admin UI for cache size override (fallback to env config)
```

Mason: +1 on deferring RBAC. curious on the timeline impact if we keep admin UI as "optional" — dev estimate? :thinking_face:

Devon: Rough numbers: cache core + eviction + metrics = ~6 dev days (2 engs), admin UI another ~3 days, RBAC/telemetry infra ~2-3 sprints (depends on infra review). If we include admin UI we should also add an e2e smoke test.

Mason: If admin UI is optional, do we need feature-flagging? How do customers toggle without UI?

Anya: Plan is env-config + rollout via console toggle later. For early pilot tenants we'll patch via infra team. Not ideal long-term but safe for MVP.

Marie: Are there active customer asks for RBAC or per-tenant telemetry that would block pilot? I heard ACME asked for tenant-level metrics last week.

Anya: ACME asked, but they said metrics are "nice to have" not mandatory for pilot. We should surface the tradeoff to them and offer early access to the simple metrics endpoint (no dashboard).

product-bot: Canary metrics: https://rwd-infer.ops/canary/embcache — latest run shows 21.7% token savings, 15.9% latency P95 improvement (run 2026-03-20). :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Devon: Given perf and small dev effort, I'm leaning to include admin UI only if we can drop noncritical polish (no RBAC integration, simple form). Otherwise ship without UI and give ops toggles.

Mason: Agree. Also: add rollback plan if cache causes increased transient errors — suggested policy: 10% error rate threshold or >2% client 5xx increase -> auto-disable cache for the affected model variant. We can implement that in the serving runtime in ~2 days.

Anya: Good rollback gating. Add to release checklist: monitor token-savings, P95, client 5xx delta. If thresholds hit, rollback and open incident.

Marie: I'll draft the customer note to ACME + beta tenants: what to expect, how to opt-out, and timeline. Will also call out deferred items (RBAC, dashboards).

Mason: One more ask: add a short perf regression test to CI that runs a small synthetic workload to validate P95 after any cache changes. Low cost (~1 job, 15-20m).

Devon: I'll scope that and add to the ticket.

Anya: OK — decision: MVP = embeddings cache + eviction + basic metrics; admin UI = conditional (ship only if we can do it without extra infra work); RBAC + dashboards = v1. Rollout: canary next Tue, ramp Wed-Thu, GA after one week of stable canary.

Marie: :thumbsup: I'll sync comms and update the launch doc.

Mason: Copy. I'll open the PR for the runtime gating and rollback rule.

Devon: I'll add the CI perf job and update the ticket with the dev day estimates.

Anya: Thanks team — filing final scope in the milestone tracker now. :rocket:
